reviews.t: Great price for a great product!
reviews.x: I tan fairly easy but I have a wedding coming up so I was trying to speed up the process and I used this lotion 1 time and went at least 2-3 shades darker. It didn’t streak or leave me with any tint of orange. Just like with any tanning lotion, you need to make sure you wash your hands and clean between your fingers after you apply the lotion. Also, I have extremely sensitive skin and this did not leave me with any reaction at all.

Great scent, no cooked smell after tanning, fantastic and immediate results. Does stain hands if you don't wash your hands pretty well after application but most with lots of good bronzers do, all in all would definitely recommend to those who want great color without going every single day. Gives you that nice, natural bronzed look, or at least it does for me.

I am a nurse that works night shift so i am very pale (even owning my own tanning bed); i purchased this and after the first use i could instantly tell a difference. After applying the lotion i washed my hands and then tanned. If you dont it will stain your hands. I will definitely buy this again and recommend it! Thanks for an excellent product!
I have used this only 3-4 times and I've noticed a drastic difference in compared to other brands/other lotions even by the same company! I definitely got darker using this!

I really liked this lotion when I first got it. Like a lot of people had mentioned my hands did turn orange. So I started bringing nylon gloves and that has worked out really well. I get a really good tan off this lotion and even more so if I'm able to let the lotion remain on the skin for about 6 hours afterwards. The only real drawback other than the potential for orange hands is the fragrance. While the iced cranberry fragrance was a welcome change when I first got it by the end of the bottle
Worked as expected. I continuously got darker as I used the lotion in a indoor tanning bed.

I'm an avid tanner and managed a salon years and years ago.  I try lots of tanners trying to find the ones that make my life easier. I would actually buy this again.  I liked the bronzing effect which is very dark and instant.  It's like a fake tan immediately that doesn't wash off right away as well as an accelerant. Only down side is it does start to wash away after a few showers :( but at least not splotchy like. Beware, like other reviewers mentioned,  this can and will leave a stain where e

reviews.t: If my body had looked like my hands after applying with a little less color ...
reviews.x: Not crazy about this product.  Reading the reviews before purchasing I was a little sceptical thinking they may exaggerated a bit. No....the review about turning your hands black when applying was on point.  But I also didn't see a lot of difference after applying.  If my body had looked like my hands after applying with a little less color would have been happy.  Now the bottle just collects dust.

Very good lotion! I have seen a difference after my second use. I use a wet wipe after putting it on since it turns my palms black but it does come off of them after a good hand scrub. It moisturizes very good also and will definitely buy more.

This is my favorite tanning lotion so far. I love it. Although you do have to rub it in pretty quickly otherwise it will leave a black mark (that does wash off easily). Also you need to wipe if off your hands right after application.

reviews.t: VERY DISAPPOINTED!! I look like a god damn ompa loompa!!
reviews.x: I bought this bronzer not knowing how dark the actual lotion was. It’s probably THE Darkest lotion Iv ever seen come out of a bottle of tanning lotion. Was soo dark that I decided to mix it with a white tanning lotion and when I did that i didn’t mind the color it gave me but then I decided to try it alone and oh my god I am straight up orange!!! Looks so ugly!! I am soo disappointed! Do not buy unless you like looking like a god damn ompa loompa!

Very DARK lotion! I noticed a difference after the first use! The only downfall is that the lotion is so dark, it leaves your hands black so be sure to wipe your hands immediately after application! Definitely worth every penny! Super satisfied with my skin color I have achieved after just 3 times of use!

reviews.t: The best product I've ever ordered.
reviews.x: Works amazingly! Smells amazingly! I have never had a better tanning lotion, I literally recommend this to everyone. Everyone compliments the smell and my tan. I've used in in salons and outside. I wish they made lotions and perfumes too, the sent is perfect!

The bronzer in this lotion is very unnatural looking...aka ORANGE! I have given it a chance a few times and it turns my hands so orange that even after washing with alcohol--its still there. Trashing this today.
Best tanning lotion I've used. Gives me the right amount of bronze I'm looking for.

reviews.t: Leaves hands looking like you work on cars
reviews.x: This product leaves a terrible color on your hands after application, like you have worked on a car. It will not wash off right away but after 3-4 x’s will have normal hands again. If you don’t mind the dirty greasy hand look it will depend you tan. Use with caution! I personally would not buy it again.

reviews.t: This tanning lotion is an excellent product.
reviews.x: I have a base tan.I like to keep my tan,throughout the year. This product is the best I’ve ever tried. Lasts long,after use. Keeps my skin smooth. I tan twice a week in winter. Once a week in summer. If you are like me, than this product won’t disappoint. Wear your gloves,when applying.

It smells good, it washes off my hands good.  But, it takes me twice the amount of shower soap to wash it off my body and after using the entire bottle, I cannot tell that I have a tan.  The worst tanning lotion I have bought.  I won't buy it again.

I gave this lotion 4 stars due to it turning my hands orange regardless of how hard I scrubbed my hands afterwords. BUT, I feel its worth it. I have a hard time tanning and with this lotion I had a nice glowing tan within a week. Its worth the buy!

reviews.t: Works PRONTO! Use a Long Handled Shower Buff to Apply. NOT your HANDS!!
reviews.x: Definitely dyes your skin PRONTO!! I would not recommend applying this lotion with your hands. I use a long handled shower buff. Works great BUT take your time applying and don’t miss any sections of your body or you will look splotchy.
This lotion is amazing...the color is great. .smells good also...I saw a difference the .first time I used it....definitely have to wear gloves for applying it though
Love it.  Works absolutely great.  I have been doing the tanning beds in preparation to Hawaii, and this tanning lotion has not disappointed.

reviews.t: Def a great product. Just be careful when applying as it ...
reviews.x: Def a great product. Just be careful when applying as it WILL stain your hands if you don't worry it off quickly.
Loved this product. Did have an odd smell, but seemed to wear off once it was applied. Will buy again.
Love this tanning lotion!  Smells like grapefruit and the bronzer leaves you a sun kissed brown!

claims.text: Many reviewers report fast, noticeable darkening results, often after just one to a few uses.
A very common complaint is that the lotion stains hands black or orange unless washed or wiped off immediately.
Several reviewers praise the scent, saying it smells great and avoids a cooked smell after tanning.
Some reviewers find the bronzer too dark or unnatural, describing an orange result.
A few reviewers note the lotion moisturizes well and is worth repurchasing.
